faq.title: Battleplan FAQ
faq.description: Verified answers about the Battleplan Steam game, its campaign, command systems and the scope of this unofficial guide.

items.question: Which Battleplan game does this site cover?
items.answer: Steam App 3743140: the World War II operational strategy game developed by Foolish Mortals Games Inc. and published by Slitherine Ltd.

items.question: When was Battleplan released?
items.answer: Steam lists October 12, 2026. The date was checked on October 13, 2026.

items.question: Is Battleplan single-player?
items.answer: Steam lists single-player. Multiplayer is not listed among the supported features at the verification date.

items.question: Is this a grand strategy game?
items.answer: The official launch overview focuses on military operations and battlefield command, rather than managing a nation, its economy or diplomacy.

items.question: Do these guides describe the old demo?
items.answer: The site targets the October 2026 release. Older developer diaries are explicitly dated, and details that have not been tested in the release build are marked as source-based.

items.question: Is this an official Battleplan wiki?
items.answer: No. Battleplan Guides is an independent Unofficial Fan Guide. Sources are linked, and the game and its trademarks belong to their respective owners.

footer.copyrightText: © 2026 Battleplan Guides. Independent fan guide. Built with AnvilWiki.

paragraphs: Battleplan Guides is an independent English-language fan guide to Battleplan on Steam, App 3743140. The game is developed by Foolish Mortals Games Inc. and published by Slitherine Ltd.

sections.heading: What we cover
items: Orders and planning, unit roles, army organization, supply and verified game reference material.
Practical steps supported by official explanations and clearly identified community evidence.

sections.heading: How we verify information
paragraphs: Articles link to their sources and carry actual review dates. Pre-release diaries are dated. We do not claim first-hand testing where none occurred, and we do not publish invented unit values, campaign walkthroughs or achievement conditions.

sections.heading: Corrections
paragraphs: Send a public correction with the page URL, the relevant game build and a supporting source. Do not include private account details or credentials.

links.label: Report a guide correction on GitHub

sections.heading: Template and artwork
paragraphs: The website uses the MIT-licensed AnvilWiki template. Our tactical illustrations are original schematics, not screenshots of the game.
This policy describes the features enabled on Battleplan Guides at the date shown.

sections.heading: Browsing and hosting
paragraphs: You can read the guides without an account. Cloudflare hosts the site and may process request data such as IP address and browser information to deliver pages, maintain logs and protect the service.

sections.heading: Optional analytics
paragraphs: Google Analytics is configured to measure page views, engagement and how visitors reach the guides. Its script loads only after you accept the cookie banner. Google can then process page URLs, interactions and device or browser information, and analytics cookies can distinguish returning visits.

Declining leaves analytics unloaded and does not restrict the guides. Your choice is stored in this browser. To choose again, clear this site's browser storage and reload it. We do not ask for account details or send player credentials to analytics.
Advertising, Cloudflare Web Analytics and embedded comments remain disabled.

sections.heading: Local browser storage
paragraphs: Theme choice, consent choice, search and page feedback may use browser storage. On-site search uses a locally served Pagefind index. There is no server-side search account.

sections.heading: External links and video
paragraphs: Following an external link takes you to a separate service with its own policies. Where a YouTube video is embedded, its thumbnail is requested from YouTube and the player loads after you choose to play it.

sections.heading: Corrections and contact
paragraphs: Public GitHub issues are visible to others and handled by GitHub. Do not submit confidential information there.

sections.heading: Use of the guide
paragraphs: The site provides information for players. It does not provide game accounts, paid services, downloads of the game or guarantees of results.

sections.heading: Accuracy and updates
paragraphs: Game updates can change behavior. Check the cited date and version scope, and follow the current game interface and official announcements when they differ.

sections.heading: Links and attribution
paragraphs: External websites are operated by their respective owners. Attribute and link to the relevant article when referring to this guide. The AnvilWiki template retains its MIT license.

sections.heading: Independence
paragraphs: Battleplan Guides is not affiliated with or endorsed by Foolish Mortals Games Inc. or Slitherine Ltd. Battleplan trademarks and game assets belong to their respective owners.

sections.heading: Ownership
paragraphs: Original editorial text and schematic artwork are created for Battleplan Guides. Battleplan and its trademarks belong to their respective owners, including Slitherine Ltd. The site claims no ownership of the game.

sections.heading: AnvilWiki
paragraphs: The underlying AnvilWiki template is provided under its MIT license, which remains included in the repository.

sections.heading: Artwork and sources
paragraphs: The initial site uses original schematic diagrams and links to official sources. Diagrams do not reproduce exact game maps, layouts or unit statistics.

sections.heading: Rights concerns
paragraphs: Include the affected URL, identify the material and explain the concern through the contact channel.

sections.heading: Contact the guide maintainer
paragraphs: Use the project issue tracker for corrections, broken links and rights concerns. It is a public channel; do not include private information.

sections.heading: Useful correction details
items: The guide URL and the inaccurate or unclear section.
Your game version, the observed behavior and an official source or reproducible description.

sections.heading: Game support
paragraphs: The fan site does not handle purchases or technical support for the game. Use the official Steam community for game support.
